## Props (CardProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | sm = spacing-4 · md = spacing-5. @default 'md' |
| `variant` | `'primary'` | 'primary' = the featured tint (opacity-10). |
| `layout` | `'block' \| 'list'` | 'list' = rows separated by 1px line. @default 'block' |
| `onClick` | `() => void` | Either makes the card pressable with a trailing chevron. |
| `href` | `string` |  |
| `as` | `string` | @default 'div' |
| `children` | `unknown` |  |
